classification: OWNER_APPROVED_ADAPTATION: story and challenge battles become runs of waves over the existing auto battle, with ground drops picked by a tap or the magnet talent; only the challenge offers leave-with-loot or fight-on after each won wave (Owner 2026-11-18)

saveField.path: progression.waveRun = { version: 1, runId, mode: STORY|CHALLENGE, encounterId, seed, party: [instanceId] (1..3), wave, waves (story), status: FIGHTING|REST, bossPresets (story), attempts: [attemptId], drops: [{ id: runId:wave:foeSlot:index, wave, slot, kind: BITS|ITEM, record?, amount, state: GROUND|PICKED|SETTLED, x, y }] } while a run is open; a finished run is never saved
saveField.migration: none: a save without it has no run; an unknown shape is no run (productWaveRun.normalizeWaveRun); a repeated drop id is kept once; a run saved mid-wave reloads as a rest before that same wave (its drops were never dropped, so nothing pays twice)

rules.shared: one wave controller (productWaveRun.js, rules in WAVE_RUN_RULES); each wave is a fresh free-battle session (kind WAVE, no purse, no sponsor stake, no per-wave Sync EXP, gacha drop, talent Bits or skill-card reward); a wave is cleared only on the settled battle result; HP and TP carry across waves through the battle write-back; at most three a side
rules.drops: a won wave drops Bits worth WAVE_RUN_RULES.dropBitsPercent of each beaten foe's purse in up to dropPilesMax piles plus, at itemChancePercent, one existing raising item (feed, wound medicine, protein, medicine); ids and amounts come from the run seed (never the battle RNG), so a reload never rerolls them; nothing is credited when a drop falls
rules.pickup: one authority (app.collectWaveDrop) for a tap and the magnet: GROUND -> PICKED once; story picks are paid at once through a speculative shop (wallet cap and item caps hold; what does not fit stays picked and unpaid) and marked SETTLED in the same save; challenge picks join the run loot
rules.story: no leave or continue choice between waves; WAVE_RUN_RULES.storyWaves waves (lower tiers, then the authored foes last); a battle that cannot start or is left is never a win: the director asks retry or back, back ends the chapter with no clear and no first-clear reward
rules.challenge: after each won wave a rest: waves cleared, picked loot, partner HP, next threat (foe count, foe boost percent); 帶著戰利品離場 settles the picked loot once and returns to the Journey challenge tab; 繼續挑戰 starts the next wave; never on a timer; leaving with drops on the ground warns on the key (second press), never a modal; waves grow from one foe to three, tier floor(n/2), foes stronger by challengeBoostPerWave percent from wave challengeBoostFrom (damage dealt and taken, not HP alone)
rules.defeat: WAVE_RUN_RULES.defeatPolicy KEEP_PICKED (Owner had not decided): picked drops are paid, ground drops are lost; LOSE_ALL is the other named setting
rules.endings: LEFT, CLEARED, DEFEATED, ABANDONED (left mid-wave or another node opened) and FAILED (could not be fought) are recorded apart; backgrounding the app is none of them
rules.magnet: trader.magnet (tier 1, one rank, key dropMagnet) collects every ground drop on a story or challenge field, one every magnetEveryMs, through the same authority; a respec stops it
rules.settlement: the run pays its Sync EXP once at its end (grantBattleSync kind FREE, won unless defeated or abandoned) and the tamer once, never per wave

notChanged: the battle engine, its RNG, AI and damage
the free battle catalog and its purses
tower, patrol, zones, sparring, titles, championship, password/link and Data Arena
